name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demem a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze zrychluje Direct2D cestu: cached material/noise/spatial/HLSL PBGRA vrstvy se skladaji pres nativni ID2D1Bitmap a diagnostika hlasi d2d_pbgra layer/bitmap citace.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version speeds up the Direct2D path: cached material/noise/spatial/HLSL PBGRA layers are composited through native ID2D1Bitmap, with d2d_pbgra layer/bitmap diagnostics.
